rich_narrative.summary: The Muslim Foundation operates educational and community initiatives in New Jersey, including the <cite id="3">Sadiq School and Jafaria School of Central Jersey</cite>. However, significant financial and governance factors limit its overall rating. In FY2024, the foundation reported <cite id="2">Total Revenue of $2,222,033</cite>, reflecting an 11% revenue decline from the previous year's $2,504,911. A primary concern is financial management: the organization maintains 74.8 months of working capital in reserves, holding excessive liquid assets without a clear public plan for deployment. Furthermore, the organization achieves a <cite id="1">71.1% program expense Ratio</cite>, which sits below the 75% industry standard and the 82.4% peer median. The organization maintains a <cite id="1">2-star rating with an overall score of 64.0/100 from Charity Navigator</cite>. On fundraising efficiency, the charity demonstrates strength, spending <cite id="1">$0.08 per $1 raised</cite>.
